rules.statement: A prosecution under the Food Act is time barred if it is instituted more than three months after the date of detection of the offence.
rules.supporting_quote: It is contended that the intention of the Legislature by imposing a time bar as contained in Section 20 (1) (b) of the Food Act for instituting an action was to ensure inter alia credibility of the Complainant, as it is with the expectation that a Complainant will initiate an action by bringing the offence to the notice of the relevant Officers at the earliest point of discovery that the offence had taken place.
